category.title: Agency Category
category.description: Select the primary category of B2B agencies to scrape.

customDirectoryUrls.title: Custom Clutch Directory URLs
customDirectoryUrls.description: Optional: Specific Clutch directory URLs to scrape (overrides category if provided). Supports city/country filtered URLs like https://clutch.co/agencies/digital-marketing/new-york.

maxAgencies.title: Maximum Agencies to Scrape
maxAgencies.description: Total number of agency profiles to extract.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. By default, direct requests or Apify proxies are supported.
